name: create_budget
description: Create a monthly cost budget in AWS Budgets (payer account). The budget only tracks spend: it stops nothing and notifies nobody. This tool CHANGES resources, so it never runs directly: calling it asks the user to confirm (or other people to approve) the exact arguments, and it runs only afterwards. Call it once with the final values; do not retry it.

name.description: Short name of the budget: letters, digits and hyphens, up to 40 characters. The installation prefix is added automatically.

amount_usd.description: Monthly limit in USD, greater than 0.

account_ids.description: Optional: 12-digit AWS account ids the budget covers. Empty or omitted: the whole organization.
